Hi Neha,

Great to meet you on the call earlier — thanks for walking us through Redwood's onboarding. Per our discussion, I've attached the initial documents for Wave Hardware so your team can start vendor/profile setup: WAVE_W9.pdf and company_registration_cert.pdf.

Quick items we want to confirm on your side so we can align internal ops:
- Legal entity to use on PO (W9 currently lists "Wave Hardware LLC" but our registered name is "Wave Hardware Inc." — we can correct any docs if needed)
- Preferred remittance address for invoices
- AP contact for invoice submission and whether Redwood supports PDF invoices to an AP inbox or requires EDI/portal submission
- PO channel: do we expect POs from RedwoodProcurement@redwood.com or via your ERP (please advise routing/email or vendor code to expect)

I've copied our FinanceOps inbox (vendor-ops@wavehardware.com) on this thread for follow-up.

Attachments: WAVE_W9.pdf (W9), company_registration_cert.pdf (state cert)

If you need anything else before we fill the supplier intake form, let me know.

Thanks,

Ada — thank you, received the W9 and registration cert. Good to meet you too.

Next steps from Redwood procurement side (requested actions + timeline):
1) Please complete the attached Supplier_Intake_Form.docx and return it with the remittance address and your AP contact details (name, email, phone). That form helps us create the vendor record and map PO/invoice channels.
2) Confirm the canonical legal name you want on Redwood POs. Kimberly and I noticed a mismatch between the W9 and registration cert — please confirm and, if needed, provide a corrected W9 (we can accept a scanned, signed PDF).
3) Let us know if you accept PDF invoices to ap@wavehardware.com and whether there is a PO requirement on every invoice (if yes, include examples).

Kimberly / Soojin — looping you in for the legal name check and a quick risk/compliance review. Marissa, FYI in case we need to accelerate a vendor code and temporary PO.

Tentative timeline: If we receive the completed intake form + corrected W9 by end of day Fri (05/21), procurement aims to provision a vendor record and vendor code by Monday 05/24, subject to compliance clearance.

Attachments referenced: Supplier_Intake_Form.docx (fillable)

Quick review: I pulled the attached artifacts Ada provided. There's a discrepancy — the registration certificate indicates "Wave Hardware Inc." while the W9 provided lists "Wave Hardware LLC."

Action items:
- Ask vendor to re-issue a W9 that matches the registered corporate name (Wave Hardware Inc.) or provide documentation explaining a legal DBA/LLC relationship.
- Put ACH/Banking setup on hold until we receive the corrected W9 and confirm tax classification.
- Compliance: Soojin, can you run the standard quick risk check (sanctions, adverse media, tax jurisdictions) once we have the corrected doc?

I recommend we continue creating the profile with provisional vendor code for PO routing (so procurement can route POs), but hold any payment method activation until docs are reconciled.
